items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He loved Oscar Peterson and Ahmad Jamal. Those were his favorite two later on

ctx.x: What was he like? You’re brothers, and he’s nine years older.

My brother was a genius. Genius pianist. Not a piano player. He was a pianist that could play in all the different genres. He loved Oscar Peterson and Ahmad Jamal. Those were his favorite two later on, Then of the Cuban players, he knew some of the...like, Peruchin earlier, and Orquesta Riverside(?—16;42). Through him, I started to listen to different bands coming along. But it was my brother and his influence... He was my main influence. By the time Charlie is 20 years old, he’s already married and with Tito…
So when you start on piano, did you have formal lessons?
